note: Written before the plain-language routing fix (2026-10-24). Each positive case is a request the way a founder or growth marketer types it, without the command name. A positive passes when the brief selects `target` (or one of `any`) and none of `none`. A play counts as selected when the brief returns it. Negative cases (`silent: true`) must return no brief from the CLI, MCP, or hooks. `area` groups the cases in reports; `ambiguous` cases fit two commands and fix the winner.
